name: Punchmark
description: A bored disc with a straight bite taken out of one side of it.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 14%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(18.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 100.0%, 18.0% 100.0%); clip-path: polygon(18.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 100.0%, 18.0% 100.0%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 16%, #000 16% 50%, transparent 50%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 16%, #000 16% 50%, transparent 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
